address: IAD37 Data Center | 44060 Digital Loudoun Plaza Bldg K | Digital Realty
44060 Digital Loudoun Plaza (Bldg K), Ashburn, VA 20147

reading.body:
IAD37 publishes 500 MW of IT capacity, which makes it the largest single campus by published IT load among the 19 Virginia facilities this site has read, and it accounts for roughly 38 percent of the 1,326 MW published across those 19 facilities. Virginia has 326 mapped facilities in total, so the vast majority publish no capacity figure, and the state's true installed base is larger than what the numbers here reflect.

At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, 500 MW of IT load is roughly 12,500 racks, and at 10 kW per accelerator card that scales to approximately 1.25 million accelerator slots across the campus. Those are assumptions about density, not claims Digital Realty has made. At 10 kW per rack, a legacy enterprise density, the same 500 MW yields 50,000 racks. The spread between those two figures is wide, and Digital Realty does not publish a rack count or a per-rack power envelope on the spec page this site read.

PCI DSS qualifies the campus to host payment card workloads under that standard's controls. ISO 27001 qualifies it to host workloads whose operators require a certified information security management system. ISO 9001 qualifies it under a quality management framework, which governs process consistency rather than security or workload type. Which tenants occupy the campus, and what fraction of the 500 MW is committed versus available, are not published.
